# Senne Vleminckx

::: {.role}
Nurse and quantitative methodologist. PhD researcher at the University of Antwerp; postdoctoral researcher in the Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences from October 2026.
:::

I study how nursing teams are put together and how they work — their composition, stability, and collaboration — mostly from hospital rostering, administrative, and survey data. My PhD developed a framework for describing team composition and a measure of collaboration built from scheduling data.

Before research I worked as a nurse in emergency and intensive care. My postdoctoral work moves towards infectious-disease modelling and health economics.
